s: Mi hem happeturim mittepilla ubo d' seipim: kol happeturim miqqeriat shema — peturim mittepilla. Vekol shechayyab biqriat shema — chayyab bitpilla, chutz mehamlavvin et hammet sheen lammitta tzorek bahen, sheap al pi shechayyabim biqriat shema — peturim mittepilla, hoil vehi middibre soperim, veod shehi baamida veen yekolin lishhot kol kak, abal qeriat shema iqqar kavvanatah vaamidatah enah ella bepasuq rishon ubeqal yukal laamod ulekavven:

Nashim vaabadim ap al pi sheppeturim miqqeriat shema — chayyabim bitpilla, mippene shehu mitzvat aseh shello hazzeman gerama, shezzemanne hattepilla hem middibre soperim, veiqqar mitzvat hattepilla hi min hattora, shenneemar: "uleobdo bekol lebabkem", ezo aboda shebballeb — zo tepilla, ella sheen lah nussach yadua min hattora veyakol lehitpallel bekol nussach sheyyirtzeh ubekol et sheyyirtzeh, umishshehitpallel paam achat bayyom o ballayla — yatza yede chobato min hattora. Veal pi sebara zo nahagu rob hannashim sheenan mitpalelin y"ch bitmidut shachar vaereb, lepi sheomerot miyyad babboqer samuk lannetila ezeh baqqasha umin hattora yotzeot bazeh, veepshar sheap chakamim lo chiyyebum yoter. Abal yesh omerim sheiqqar mitzvat tepilla hi middibre soperim, shehem anshe keneset haggedola shettiqqenu y"ch berakot al hasseder, lehitpallel otan shacharit umincha choba vearbit reshut, veap al pi shehu mitzvat aseh middibre soperim shehazzeman gerama, vehannashim peturot mikkol mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama apillu hi middibre soperim kegon hallel veqiddush hallebana — ap al pi ken chiyyebu otan bitpillat shacharit umincha, hoil utepilla hi baqqashat rachamim. Veken iqqar. Abal tepillat arbit shehu reshut, ap al pi sheakshav kebar qibbeluhu alehem kol yisrael lechoba, mikkol maqom hannashim lo qibbelu alehem verubban enan mitpallelot arbit bem"sh:

Qetannim shehiggiu lechinnuk — chayyabim lechannekam lehitpallel y"ch ereb vaboqer. Umikkol maqom, rashshay litten lahem leekol qodem tepillat shacharit veasur leannotam, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rs"t vesham"g leinyan lehaakilam qodem qiddush:

Mi shettorato ummanuto kegon rabbi shimon ben yochay vachaberayv — mapsiq liqriat shema umebarek lepaneha uleachareha, abal eno mitpallel kol iqqar, kevan shemmibbalade ken eno mebattel millimmudo apillu rega — gam bishbil hattepilla lo yebattel. Veap shetztzarik lebattel ulehapsiq limmudo laasiyyat kol hammitzvot apillu shel dibre soperim, mikkol maqom tepilla hoil veenah ella baqqashat rachamim al inyene olam hazzeh — en lo lehaniach chayye haolam velaasoq bechayye shaa. Abal anu mapsiqin ben liqriat shema ben litpilla, kevan shemmibbalade ken anu mebattelin harbeh. Umikkol maqom, im melammed laacherim veim lo yilmedu akshav yitbattelu velo yukelu lehitqabbetz lilmod achar hattepilla — lo yipsoq millimmudo immahem apillu im yaabor zeman hattepilla. Umikkol maqom, poseq veqore pasuq rishon shel qeriat shema, kede leqabbel malkut shamayim bizman qeriat shema. Veyachazor achar halaka sheyyesh bah yetziat mitzrayim, kede lehazkir yetziat mitzrayim bizman qeriat shema. Veachar limmudo tob sheyyigmor kol qeriat shema. Veap al pi sheabar zemannah — lo hipsid, keadam sheqqore battora. Veim en hashshaa oberet veyesh lo shehut adayin liqrot qeriat shema ulehitpallel — eno poseq kelal, apillu lomed yechidi, vaapillu hitchil lilmod beissur leachar shekkebar higgia zeman qeriat shema utepilla, sheasur lo lehatchil lilmod ad sheyyitpallel techilla im eno ragil lelek lebet hakkeneset kemo shennitbaer besiman p"t, ap al pi ken im hitchil en tzarik lehapsiq, verashshay lilmod kol zeman sheyyesh shehut adayin liqrot qeriat shema ulehitpallel achar kak:
